name: GATE

name: CAT
opportunities: MBA at IIMs, FMS, MDI, XLRI, SPJIMR — leads to consulting/product management roles.

name: GRE
whoShouldTake: Students planning MS abroad (US, Germany, Singapore).

name: ISRO Scientist
